verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a work-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only vendor-hosted infrastructure ('Your syncs and tools run on our infra, not yours'; 'Your data never leaves our secure servers') and documents no self-hostable edition of the core product. The open-source Vibe React components are an adjacent UI library, not the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
